text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with<n>Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy points toward a claw<n>machine filled
with Umamusume<n>plushies.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
These days, everyone's goin' places<n>with their
Cuties and taking pics to<n>post on Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I bet ya I'd get a ton of attention if I<n>had one! I can
already see the likes<n>streamin' in!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, Cuties! I'mma getcha<n>right now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, whaaa?! How'd I already burn<n>through my
allowance for this<n>month?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nghhh... And I really wanted one of<n>those Cuties...
choice_data_list: Do you want me to win you one?
Do you want me to win you one?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You'd really do that?! Awesome!<n>Then I'm
counting on ya!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't really care which one, so just<n>grab
anything! I'll be here cheerin'<n>ya on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
